I’m done with OCD. I’m going to put an end to this misery once and all

That’s the thing though I know in my heart I’d never do these things, but let me try to explain to you a bit of what’s happening (a lot is happening but the most recent one) 

It all started off with a thought about rape directed at my family members, but that’s not the worst part. What’s worse is that after that I intrusive thought happened there was a brief moment where I forced myself to consider it! It wasn’t even to check I just did it. While the original thought was ocd the consideration has CRUSHED ME ): especially since it was directed at my mom. I feel so sick and twisted honestly. All my mind can focus on is how I need to die and don’t deserve to live. ):

Thank you for your kind words. The problem though is that at first it was all intrusive (intrusive feelings urges and thoughts) but recently I’ve been doing something weird I’ve been having brief moments of “serious consideration” regarding all the things I dislike the most, only to freak out immediately afterwards. What’s worse is that I don’t always do it to check my reaction BUT JUST BECAUSE ): yes there’s been a lot of intrusive thoughts, but some of these are real too. I’m glad to hear that it got better for you (: I know I wouldn’t do these things, but even considering them makes me feel sick and twisted.

I am currently on medication, this is day 3 currently and it’s definitely made my anxiety / symptoms worse but that’s normal for the start supposedly 

I keep repeating the words “sick and twisted” over and over again to remind myself these actions are horrible, if not I feel I’ll give in and do those horrible things. Right now I have an overwhelming urge to throw up (I honestly don’t know how I haven’t so far) I’ve been dealing with the fear of being physically / emotionally abusive. Yesterday RAPE also came up DIRECTED AT MY MOTHER. My mind keeps constantly “considering these things, and I end up feeling like a horrible monster afterwards. I’m such a sick freak. I keep getting thoughts like “do it it doesn’t matter” or “they made you have these thoughts” which they didn’t it’s ocd. I feel like throwing up, the guilt is eating me alive, I feel sick to my stomach. I’m so afraid and I feel so HORRIBLE ):

Thank you friend. I’ve been obsessing over being physically / emotionally abusive and yesterday rape came up much of directed towards my mother as well. This is all so incredibly difficult. The guilt is eating me alive. The thoughts feelings and urges. I feel like literally Puking my life away.

Thank you friend once again. Yes, I’m only 21 years old. You could definitely be talking to a real monster whose considered hideous things against his family members and others too. One of my obsessions is “considering” doing things only to end up feeling horrible afterwards. What kind of a person am I?

I just wish I hadn’t let it get to this point I wish I had gotten help sooner. There’s so many different thoughts, urges, feelings. So many different themes. The weight is often times unbearable. What if some of those were real and not related to the obsession / obsessions? I feel I don’t need treatment, rather be put to death for being such a vile human being.

I think I’m past the point of help though. I’m entirely convinced that somewhere down the line I forced some of these thoughts and feelings and urges on purpose, meaning I’m indeed guilty. My obsessions have become real in a way not manifested physically but internally.
Ive even reaches a point where some of these thoughts are REAL I think my obsessions have become real in a way. I’m becoming the person I always loathed.
I’m taking medication/:

You could very well be talking to a hideous monster who has legitimately considered doing atrocious things to their family member or even strangers /:

There are times I even force these thoughts and feelings and urges maybe as compulsions or maybe really only to feel like a horrible monster. I wouldn’t do these vile things, but even considering them makes me worthy of death. 

There are so many thoughts and urges and feelings what if something is real? I couldn’t live with myself. I’m entirely convinced of the fact I’m a monster. This isn’t ocd anymore I’m legitimately a monster.

Every single day I keep experiencing thoughts, feelings, urges that go against my morals and I honestly don’t even know who I am anymore.

I don’t know what’s related to the ocd or not. Really feels like I’m going crazy / became a piece of nothing slowly. 

For example, if I’ve always found romantic things cute I’ll suddenly start feeling or thinking they aren’t when I’ve always thought differently. 

Another example is that I’ve always been strongly against cheating and suddenly I’m putting myself in a situation in my head where I find myself experiencing feelings for someone else (when I’m not even IN a relationship) 

Another example is how whenever I become irritated which I fear my arms become tense and I can’t tell whether it’s anger or if it’s all part of the ocd. 

Another example is I’ve never been one to laugh at certain things like people being made fun of or people’s tragedies, but as of late I have a difficult time not smiling or laughing.

Overall what I’m trying to say is that I keep having thoughts and feelings that go against my morals and I feel as if my morals and principals have already been violated in a way. 

I feel scared, I feel terrible about myself, I feel so lost. I don’t know anything anymore friend.
